name: Accelink Technologies Co., Ltd.
blurb: Accelink Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in the research, development, and manufacturing of optical communication devices and modules. The company provides key components for fiber-optic networks, including transceivers, amplifiers, and passive components, serving telecom and data center markets. It is a leading supplier in China's optical communication industry and competes globally with other optoelectronic firms.
